title: The node text field edits more than one line
body:
`Field` in `field.rs` edits a node's text in a one-line una field, since una has no multi-line entry yet (una-d1d8cd). `Field::open` shows a line break as the two characters `\n`, and writing the field turns `\n` back into a line break. A literal backslash followed by `n` cannot be typed. Shift+Enter writes the text as Enter does, and Escape closes the field without writing.

## Proposal

Once una has multi-line entry, the field moves to it. Shift+Enter starts a new line again, as the viewer's keys in `CLAUDE.md` say, and the `\n` stand-in goes.
close_reason: Landed in 5b72c4e. The node text field is una's multi-line box: Enter starts a line, Ctrl+Enter writes, and the `\n` stand-in is gone.
